name: W self-loop removal
summary: A plain self-loop on the outputs of a W-node can be removed.
description:
The W-node (black triangle) with one input and $n$ outputs maps $|0\rangle \mapsto |0\cdots 0\rangle$ and $|1\rangle \mapsto |10\cdots0\rangle + |010\cdots0\rangle + \cdots + |0\cdots01\rangle$: it spreads a single excitation over its outputs in all possible ways. The small dot marks its input leg.

Connecting two outputs of a W-node to each other (a trace) keeps only the terms where both are $|0\rangle$, since at most one output carries the excitation. So the loop can simply be removed. In the undirected ZW-calculus this is the rule $tr_W$: a black vertex with a self-loop is a black vertex with two fewer legs. Together with [W fusion](../w-fusion/) it makes up the spider presentation of the black vertices.
parameter_notes: Shown for a W-node with two remaining outputs; holds for any number of outputs.
